kebab_example: aliyun imm list-triggers --project-name test-project --state Succeeded --sort 2020-11-11T06:51:17.5Z --order ASC --tag-selector test=val1 --next-token MTIzNDU2Nzg6aW1tdGVzdDpleGFtcGxlYnVja2V0OmRhdGFzZXQwMDE6b3NzOi8vZXhhbXBsZWJ1Y2tldC9zYW1wbGVvYmplY3QxLmpwZw== --max-results 10 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTriggers

parameters.help_en: The name of the project. You can obtain the name of the project from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478153.html operation
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the trigger. Valid values:

Ready: The trigger is ready.
Running: The trigger is running.
Failed: The trigger failed and cannot be automatically recovered.
Suspended: The trigger is suspended.
Succeeded: The trigger is complete
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态：

Ready：任务就绪，刚创建的任务处于Ready状态。
Running：正在执行，正常执行的任务状态。
Failed：任务失败，任务执行出错，且无法自动恢复。
Suspended：任务暂停。
Succeeded：任务执行完成
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
The sort field. Valid values:

CreateTime: the point in time when the trigger is created.
UpdateTime: the most recent point in time when the trigger is updated
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，取值范围如下：

CreateTime：按任务创建时间排序。

UpdateTime：按任务更新时间排序
parameters.name: sort

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Default value: DESC.

ASC (default): ascending order.
DESC: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式，默认值为DESC。

ASC：升序
DESC：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The custom tag. You can specify this parameter only if you specified Tags when you called the CreateTrigger operation
parameters.help_zh: 自定义任务标签。在创建任务时如果指定了“Tags”参数，可以通过此参数进行搜索
parameters.name: tag_selector

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

If the total number of triggers is greater than the value of MaxResults, you must specify NextToken.

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh:
翻页标记。

当文件总数大于设置的MaxResults时，用于翻页的Token。从NextToken开始按字典序返回文件信息列表。

第一次调用此接口时，设置为空
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 0 to 100.

Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
返回文件的最大个数，取值范围为0~100。

不设置此参数或者设置为0时，则默认值为100
parameters.name: max_results
